front: The four values of the Code
back: Responsibility, respect, fairness, honesty.
Aspirational: conduct we strive for. Mandatory: firm requirements; violations go to PMI's Ethics Review Committee.
Uphold laws and policies, report unethical or illegal conduct, file complaints only on facts, no retaliation.
Negotiate in good faith; no using position for personal gain; no abuse; respect property rights.
Disclose real or potential conflicts; stay out of the decision until disclosed, mitigated and approved; treat the appearance as real.
No deceiving: no false statements, half-truths, or withheld information that would mislead.
